description: Names System Reference Document 5.1 does not carry. Any match in a generated 2014 file fails the build; matches are resolved by the rename map or a reviewed prose edit recorded in srd-5.1.map.json. Entries are regular expressions applied case-insensitively; keep them to possessive or whole-word forms. Setting names the document itself uses (Forgotten Realms, Faerûn, Strahd in Divine Sense, the Deck of Many Things cards) are deliberately absent.
